scope: Existing full recovered frontier summaries, exact source records preserved; no training, evaluation, or new hypothesis tests.

metric_definitions.error_ratio_cluster_geomean: Competitor RMS / rank1 RMS: log-average schedules, grids and registered seeds within each independent field, then equally weight fields; >1 favors rank1 accuracy.
metric_definitions.max_ratio_cluster_geomean: Competitor maximum error / rank1 maximum error; same field averaging; >1 favors rank1.
metric_definitions.speed_ratio_cluster_geomean: Competitor latency / rank1 latency on same primary schedules; >1 favors rank1 speed, without accuracy qualification.
metric_definitions.native_error_ratio_and_speed_ratio: Existing field-cluster geometric means; descriptive 95% field-cluster bootstrap conditional on registered training seeds. No multiplicity correction/superiority test.
metric_definitions.frontier_geomean_speed_ratio: Competitor best measured feasible endpoint cost / candidate best measured feasible endpoint cost, only mutually feasible cells; all excluded cases retained by count. >1 favors candidate. Post-hoc reference-informed selection, not deployed policy.
metric_definitions.error_n8_over_n32: Same family, matched primary endpoints: RMS with 8 training fields / RMS with 32 fields. >1 favors larger subset. Fixed update budget, not a data-efficiency law.
metric_definitions.scaling_speed_ratio: Competitor resident-state complete rollout median / rank1 median, shared input transfer separately recorded. All endpoints in this cohort accuracy-qualified.
metric_definitions.strongest_classical: Best observed feasible endpoint among DF, ETDRK4, analytic quadratic and analytic quadratic+cubic; a derived oracle frontier, not another trained architecture.
metric_definitions.non_independence: Tables overlap: pooled, grid, regime, horizon, gate and scaling summaries must not be summed into independent evidence. Confirmation unit=continuous field (24), scaling unit=4 distinct fields.
metric_definitions.primary_schedules: Identical declared endpoint schedules for paired attribution; analytic/classical controls have 1/2/4/8-step extra endpoint choices for frontier only. Neural one/two-step alternatives at same full horizon were not measured.
